questions.stem: The equation $x^3 - 2x - 5 = 0$ can be rearranged to $x = \sqrt[3]{2x + 5}$. Using $x_0 = 2$, find $x_1$ to 4 decimal places.
Using the iterative formula $x_{n+1} = \frac{5}{x_n + 2}$ with $x_0 = 1$, find $x_2$ as a fraction.
If an iterative formula converges to $x = 1.5$, which equation does $x = 1.5$ approximately satisfy?

options.text: The original equation that was rearranged into the iterative formula

questions.explanation: When the iteration converges, setting $x_{n+1} = x_n = x$ in the iterative formula gives the original equation. So the limit is an approximate solution to the original equation.
